# JUImage 5.21

`lib_juimage_v5.21.zip` is the library archive `packages/lib_juimage.zip` taken without changes from the official release
[pkg_juimage_v5.21.zip](https://github.com/Joomla-Ukraine/JUImage/releases/tag/5.21) of [JUImage](https://github.com/Joomla-Ukraine/JUImage)
by Denys Nosov, Joomla! Ukraine.

- release package sha256: `b14a136ed41c5d3c2612034991cc6d149d3f0ca6d5500b19ded569f92234e1bd`
- library archive sha256: `c1fedcf63295f102dcce867af950b3b7cbd9ec1d6955e5a41837d585994195cc`
- license: GNU GPL version 2 or later, see `LICENSE.md` (the library manifest also names CC BY-NC-ND 3.0)

`build.sh` puts this archive into the package as `packages/lib_juimage.zip`; the package installer script installs it only when the site has no
`libraries/juimage/vendor/autoload.php`.

Архив взят без изменений из официального выпуска JUImage 5.21 (автор — Денис Носов, Joomla! Ukraine). Пакет ставит его, только если на сайте
нет `libraries/juimage/vendor/autoload.php`.
